# Dust

A small command-line tool to quickly see which directories and files are using the most disk space.

Demo:

![Example](media/snap.png)

Overview

Dust prints a compact view of the biggest subdirectories or files. It automatically recurses into large subtrees so you can quickly find the biggest consumers of disk space. The display uses bars and colors to indicate relative usage and which parent folders subfolders belong to.

Usage

```
Usage: dust
Usage: dust <dir>
Usage: dust <dir> <another_dir> <and_more>
Usage: dust -p  (full-path - Show fullpath of the subdirectories)
Usage: dust -s  (apparent-size - shows the length of the file as opposed to the amount of disk space it uses)
Usage: dust -n 30  (Shows 30 directories instead of the default [default is terminal height])
Usage: dust -d 3  (Shows 3 levels of subdirectories)
Usage: dust -D (Show only directories)
Usage: dust -F (Show only files - finds your largest files)
Usage: dust -r (reverse order of output)
Usage: dust -o si/b/kb/kib/mb/mib/gb/gib (output format)
Usage: dust -X ignore  (ignore all files and directories with the name 'ignore')
Usage: dust -x (Only show directories on the same filesystem)
Usage: dust -b (Do not show percentages or draw ASCII bars)
Usage: dust -B (--bars-on-right - Percent bars moved to right side of screen)
Usage: dust -i (Do not show hidden files)
Usage: dust -c (No colors [monochrome])
Usage: dust -C (Force colors)
Usage: dust -f (Count files instead of diskspace)
Usage: dust -t (Group by filetype)
Usage: dust -z 10M (min-size, Only include files larger than 10M)
Usage: dust -e regex (Only include files matching this regex)
Usage: dust -v regex (Exclude files matching this regex)
Usage: dust -L (dereference-links - Treat symlinks as directories)
Usage: dust -P (Disable the progress indicator)
Usage: dust -R (For screen readers. Removes bars/symbols. Adds new column: depth level.)
Usage: dust -S (Custom Stack size)
Usage: dust --skip-total (No total row will be displayed)
Usage: dust -j (Prints JSON representation of directories)
Usage: dust --files0-from=FILE (Read NUL-terminated file paths from FILE)
Usage: dust --files-from=FILE (Read newline-terminated file paths from FILE)
Usage: dust --collapse=node-modules (Keep node_modules collapsed in display)
```

Config

Dust can read configuration from `~/.config/dust/config.toml` or `~/.dust.toml` to set default options.

Alternatives

- NCDU
- dutree
- dua
- pdu
- dirstat-rs

def should_ignore_path(path, name, opt:Options, is_root=False):
    if is_root: return False
    if opt.ignore_hidden and name.startswith('.'):
        return True
    for pat in opt.ignore_dirs:
        if name==pat or path==pat or os.path.abspath(path)==os.path.abspath(pat): return True
    return False


def time_match(ts, spec):
    m=re.match(r'^([+-]?)(\d+)$', spec or '')
    if not m: return True
    sign,n=m.group(1),int(m.group(2))
    days=int((time.time()-ts)//86400)
    if sign=='+': return days>n
    if sign=='-': return days<n
    return days==n


def filter_file_path(path,opt):
    if opt.ignore_regex:
        ok=False
        for r in opt.ignore_regex:
            try:
                if re.search(r,path): ok=True; break
            except re.error: pass
        if not ok: return False
    for r in opt.invert_regex:
        try:
            if re.search(r,path): return False
        except re.error: pass
    return True


def node_base_size(st,opt,is_regular):
    if opt.filecount:
        return 1 if is_regular else 0
    if opt.filetime:
        if opt.filetime=='a': return int(st.st_atime)
        if opt.filetime=='c': return int(st.st_ctime)
        return int(st.st_mtime)
    if opt.apparent:
        return int(st.st_size)
    return int(getattr(st,'st_blocks',0))*512


def scan(path,opt:Options,is_root=True, root_dev=None, parent=None):
    try:
        st=os.stat(path) if opt.deref else os.lstat(path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None, f"No such file or directory: {path}\n"
    except PermissionError:
        return None, f"Did not have permissions for: {path}\n"
    except Exception as ex:
        return None, f"{ex}: {path}\n"
    name=os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep)) or path
    mode=st.st_mode
    islink=os.path.islink(path)
    isdir=stat.S_ISDIR(mode)
    isreg=stat.S_ISREG(mode)
    if islink and opt.deref:
        islink=False
        isdir=os.path.isdir(path)
        isreg=os.path.isfile(path) and not isdir
    node=Node(path=path,name=name,is_dir=isdir,is_file=isreg,is_symlink=islink,parent=parent)
    if root_dev is None: root_dev=st.st_dev
    if opt.time_filter and isreg:
        kind,spec=opt.time_filter
        ts=st.st_mtime if kind=='m' else (st.st_atime if kind=='a' else st.st_ctime)
        if not time_match(ts,spec):
            return None, None
    include_self=filter_file_path(path,opt) if isreg else True
    base=node_base_size(st,opt,isreg) if include_self else 0
    node.raw_size=base
    if isdir and not (islink and not opt.deref):
        try:
            entries=list(os.scandir(path))
        except PermissionError:
            node.size=base
            return node, (f"Did not have permissions for: {path}\n" if opt.print_errors else None)
        except Exception as ex:
            node.size=base
            return node, (f"{ex}: {path}\n" if opt.print_errors else None)
        total=base if not opt.filetime else base
        child_errors=[]
        for ent in entries:
            cp=ent.path
            cname=ent.name
            if should_ignore_path(cp,cname,opt): continue
            if opt.limit_filesystem:
                try:
                    cst=os.stat(cp) if opt.deref else os.lstat(cp)
                    if cst.st_dev != root_dev: continue
                except Exception: pass
            child,err=scan(cp,opt,False,root_dev,node)
            if err: child_errors.append(err)
            if child is not None:
                node.children.append(child)
                if opt.filetime:
                    total=max(total, child.size)
                else:
                    total += child.size
        node.size=total
        node.sort_children()
        node.error=''.join(child_errors) if child_errors else None
        return node, node.error
    else:
        node.size=base
        return (node if include_self or not isreg else None), None


def fmt_size(n,opt):
    if opt.filecount:
        return str(int(n))
    if opt.filetime:
        try: return time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(n))
        except Exception: return '1970-01-01T00:00:00'
    fmt=opt.outfmt
    if fmt=='auto':
        base=1024; units=['B','K','M','G','T']
        v=float(n); idx=0
        while idx<len(units)-1 and v>=base:
            v/=base; idx+=1
        if idx==0: return f"{int(n)}B"
        if v<10: return f"{v:.1f}{units[idx]}"
        return f"{int(v)}{units[idx]}"
    if fmt=='si':
        base=1000; units=['B','K','M','G','T']
        v=float(n); idx=0
        while idx<len(units)-1 and v>=base:
            v/=base; idx+=1
        if idx==0: return f"{int(n)}B"
        if v<10: return f"{v:.1f}{units[idx]}"
        return f"{int(v)}{units[idx]}"
    mults={'b':(1,'B'),'k':(1024,'K'),'m':(1024**2,'M'),'g':(1024**3,'G'),'t':(1024**4,'T'),
           'kb':(1000,'K'),'mb':(1000**2,'M'),'gb':(1000**3,'G'),'tb':(1000**4,'T')}
    div,suf=mults.get(fmt,(1,'B'))
    return f"{int(n//div)}{suf}"


def display_name(node,opt):
    if node.name in ('(total)','(no extension)') or node.name.startswith('.') and opt.file_types:
        return node.name
    return node.path if opt.full_paths else (os.path.basename(node.path.rstrip(os.sep)) or node.path)


def clone_shallow(n):
    return Node(path=n.path,name=n.name,size=n.size,raw_size=n.raw_size,is_dir=n.is_dir,is_file=n.is_file,is_symlink=n.is_symlink,children=[],parent=n.parent)


def filter_display_tree(root,opt, depth=0):
    # returns a copied/pruned tree for rendering; sizes are original aggregate sizes
    n=clone_shallow(root)
    collapsed=any(root.name==c or root.path==c for c in opt.collapse)
    if opt.depth is not None and depth>=opt.depth:
        return n
    if collapsed:
        return n
    for ch in root.children:
        child=filter_display_tree(ch,opt,depth+1)
        show=True
        if opt.only_file:
            show=(not ch.children)  # files, symlinks, and empty directories
        elif opt.only_dir:
            show=(ch.is_dir or ch.is_symlink or ch.children)
        if opt.min_size is not None and ch.size < opt.min_size:
            show=False
        if show:
            n.children.append(child)
        elif child.children and not opt.only_file:
            # keep matching descendants for regex/time/min filters if useful
            n.children.extend(child.children)
    n.sort_children()
    return n


def flatten_nodes(root, reverse=False, include_root=True):
    res=[]
    def post(n, depth, ancestors, sibling_index, sibling_count):
        for i,ch in enumerate(sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name))):
            post(ch,depth+1,ancestors+[(sibling_index,sibling_count)],i,len(n.children))
        if include_root or depth>0:
            res.append((n,depth,ancestors,sibling_index,sibling_count))
    def pre(n, depth, ancestors, sibling_index, sibling_count):
        if include_root or depth>0:
            res.append((n,depth,ancestors,sibling_index,sibling_count))
        children=sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)
        for i,ch in enumerate(children):
            pre(ch,depth+1,ancestors+[(sibling_index,sibling_count)],i,len(children))
    if reverse: pre(root,0,[],0,1)
    else: post(root,0,[],0,1)
    return res


def count_nodes_excluding_root(n):
    return sum(1+count_nodes_excluding_root(c) for c in n.children)


def prune_by_n(root,opt):
    if opt.nlines is None: return root
    if count_nodes_excluding_root(root) <= opt.nlines: return root
    # select n largest descendants; include ancestors needed to reach them
    allnodes=[]
    def walk(n):
        for c in n.children:
            allnodes.append(c); walk(c)
    walk(root)
    selected=set(id(x) for x in sorted(allnodes,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)[:max(0,opt.nlines)])
    def copy_keep(n, isroot=False):
        cn=clone_shallow(n)
        for c in n.children:
            cc=copy_keep(c)
            if cc is not None:
                cn.children.append(cc)
        keep=isroot or id(n) in selected or cn.children
        cn.sort_children()
        return cn if keep else None
    return copy_keep(root, True)


def make_filetype_tree(root,opt):
    groups: Dict[str,int]={}
    def walk(n):
        if n.children:
            # account for directory/symlink/extensionless self contribution approximately
            extra=max(0,n.raw_size)
            if extra: groups['(no extension)']=groups.get('(no extension)',0)+extra
            for c in n.children: walk(c)
        else:
            base=os.path.basename(n.path)
            ext=os.path.splitext(base)[1]
            key=ext if ext else '(no extension)'
            groups[key]=groups.get(key,0)+n.size
    walk(root)
    total=Node(path='(total)', name='(total)', size=root.size, is_dir=True)
    for k,v in groups.items():
        total.children.append(Node(path=k,name=k,size=v))
    total.sort_children()
    return total


def connector_normal(n, depth, ancestors, idx, cnt, has_children, is_root):
    if is_root:
        return '┌─┴' if has_children else '┌──'
    pref=''
    for aidx,acnt in ancestors[1:]:  # skip synthetic root ancestor context
        pref += ('│ ' if aidx>0 else '  ')
    if has_children:
        conn='┌─┴' if idx==0 else '├─┴'
    else:
        conn='┌──' if idx==0 else '├──'
    return pref+conn


def connector_reverse(n, depth, ancestors, idx, cnt, has_children, is_root):
    if is_root:
        return '└─┬' if has_children else '└──'
    pref=''
    for aidx,acnt in ancestors[1:]:
        pref += ('│ ' if aidx < acnt-1 else '  ')
    last=(idx==cnt-1)
    if has_children:
        conn='└─┬' if last else '├─┬'
    else:
        conn='└──' if last else '├──'
    return pref+conn


def adjust_for_skip(entries):
    # If root is omitted, reduce displayed depth/ancestor context by one level.
    out=[]
    for n,d,anc,idx,cnt in entries:
        out.append((n,max(0,d-1),anc[1:] if anc else [],idx,cnt))
    return out


def render_lines(root,opt):
    include_root=not opt.skip_total
    entries=flatten_nodes(root,opt.reverse,include_root=True)
    if not include_root:
        entries=[e for e in entries if e[1]>0]
        entries=adjust_for_skip(entries)
    # no displayed root for single file and skip-total -> no lines
    if not entries: return []
    size_strs={id(n):fmt_size(n.size,opt) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries}
    sw=max(len(s) for s in size_strs.values())
    plain=[]
    for n,depth,anc,idx,cnt in entries:
        isroot=(depth==0 and include_root)
        has=bool(n.children)
        conn=connector_reverse(n,depth,anc,idx,cnt,has,isroot) if opt.reverse else connector_normal(n,depth,anc,idx,cnt,has,isroot)
        gap=' '
        if include_root and not isroot: gap='   '
        # filetime output in the original has no space after connector
        sep='' if opt.filetime else ' '
        left=f"{size_strs[id(n)]:>{sw}}{gap}{conn}{sep}{display_name(n,opt)}"
        plain.append((left,n,depth,anc))
    if opt.no_bars or opt.screen_reader:
        if opt.screen_reader:
            return render_screen_reader(entries,opt,size_strs)
        return [x[0] for x in plain]
    maxleft=max(len(x[0]) for x in plain)
    width=max(20,opt.width)
    content_width=max(1, width - maxleft - 7)  # bar border + percent field
    total=max(root.size,1)
    # top-level ancestor sizes for shaded branch bars
    def top_ancestor_size(n,anc):
        cur=n
        while cur.parent is not None and cur.parent.parent is not None:
            cur=cur.parent
        return cur.size if cur is not None else n.size
    lines=[]
    for left,n,depth,anc in plain:
        pct=0 if total==0 else int(round(n.size*100/total))
        if opt.filetime: pct=100 if n.size else 0
        full=max(1, int(round((n.size/total)*content_width))) if n.size>0 or total==0 else 1
        full=min(content_width,full)
        shade=0
        if depth>1 and not opt.filetime:
            top=top_ancestor_size(n,anc)
            topfull=max(1,int(round((top/total)*content_width))) if top>0 else 1
            shade=max(0,min(content_width-full, topfull-full))
        if opt.bars_right:
            bar=' '*(content_width-full-shade)+'░'*shade+'█'*full
        else:
            bar='█'*full+'░'*shade+' '*(content_width-full-shade)
        line=left + ' '*(maxleft-len(left)) + '│' + bar + '│' + f"{pct:>4}%"
        if len(line)<width: line += ' '*(width-len(line))
        elif len(line)>width: line=line[:width]
        lines.append(line)
    return lines


def render_screen_reader(entries,opt,size_strs):
    names=[display_name(n,opt) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries]
    maxn=max((len(x) for x in names), default=0)
    maxs=max((len(size_strs[id(n)]) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries), default=0)
    total=max(entries[-1][0].size if not opt.reverse else entries[0][0].size, 1)
    out=[]
    for (n,depth,anc,idx,cnt),name in zip(entries,names):
        pct=0 if total==0 else int(round(n.size*100/total))
        if opt.filetime: pct=100 if n.size else 0
        out.append(f"{name:<{maxn}} {depth} {size_strs[id(n)]:>{maxs}} {pct:>3}%")
    return out


def to_json_obj(n,opt):
    return {"size":fmt_size(n.size,opt),"name":display_name(n,opt),"children":[to_json_obj(c,opt) for c in sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)]}


def maybe_progress(opt):
    if opt.no_progress: return
    # The original emits a short carriage-return spinner on stderr even when captured.
    sys.stderr.write("\r \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... -\r                            \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... \\\r                            \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... |\r                            \r")


def main(argv):
    opt=parse_args(argv)
    roots=[]; errors=[]
    for p in opt.paths:
        n,err=scan(p,opt,True)
        if err: errors.append(err)
        if n is not None: roots.append(n)
    if not roots:
        for e in errors: sys.stderr.write(e)
        return 1
    if len(roots)==1:
        root=roots[0]
    else:
        root=Node(path='(total)',name='(total)',is_dir=True,size=sum(r.size for r in roots),children=roots)
        for r in roots: r.parent=root
        root.sort_children()
    if opt.file_types:
        root=make_filetype_tree(root,opt)
    else:
        root=filter_display_tree(root,opt,0)
        root=prune_by_n(root,opt)
    if opt.output_json:
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(to_json_obj(root,opt), separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    else:
        for line in render_lines(root,opt):
            sys.stdout.write(line+'\n')
    for e in errors:
        if e: sys.stderr.write(e)
    maybe_progress(opt)
    return 0

if __name__=='__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def parse_int_value(val, optname, placeholder):
    try:
        if val.startswith('-'):
            # unsigned clap parser rejects leading minus for integer options; message is close enough
            return int(val)
        return int(val)
    except Exception:
        clap_error(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '{optname} <{placeholder}>': invalid digit found in string")


def parse_size(s):
    try:
        m=re.match(r'^([0-9]+)([A-Za-z]*)$', s.strip())
        if not m: return None
        n=int(m.group(1)); u=m.group(2).lower()
        mult={"":1,"b":1,"k":1024,"kb":1000,"m":1024**2,"mb":1000**2,"g":1024**3,"gb":1000**3,"t":1024**4,"tb":1000**4}.get(u)
        if mult is None: return None
        return n*mult
    except Exception:
        return None


def read_config_file(path, opt):
    if not path: return
    try:
        data=open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        sys.stderr.write(f'Config file "{path}" doesn\'t exists\n')
        return
    except Exception:
        return
    mapping={
        'reverse': ('reverse', bool),
        'display-full-paths': ('full_paths', bool),
        'display-apparent-size': ('apparent', bool),
        'no-colors': ('no_colors', bool),
        'no-bars': ('no_bars', bool),
        'skip-total': ('skip_total', bool),
        'ignore-hidden': ('ignore_hidden', bool),
        'number-of-lines': ('nlines', int),
        'output-format': ('outfmt', str),
    }
    for line in data:
        line=line.split('#',1)[0].strip()
        if not line or '=' not in line: continue
        k,v=[x.strip() for x in line.split('=',1)]
        if k not in mapping: continue
        attr,typ=mapping[k]
        if typ is bool:
            setattr(opt, attr, v.lower() in ('true','1','yes','on'))
        elif typ is int:
            try: setattr(opt, attr, int(v))
            except: pass
        else:
            if (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')) or (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")):
                v=v[1:-1]
            if k=='output-format':
                setattr(opt, attr, 'auto' if v in ('', 'default') else v)
            else: setattr(opt, attr, v)


def load_default_config(opt, argv):
    cfg=None
    for i,a in enumerate(argv):
        if a=='--config' and i+1 < len(argv): cfg=argv[i+1]
        elif a.startswith('--config='): cfg=a.split('=',1)[1]
    if cfg:
        read_config_file(cfg,opt)
    else:
        home=os.environ.get('HOME','')
        for p in [os.path.join(home,'.config','dust','config.toml'), os.path.join(home,'.dust.toml')]:
            if p and os.path.exists(p):
                read_config_file(p,opt); break


def read_paths_from_file(fname, nul=False):
    try:
        if fname=='-':
            data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        else:
            data=open(fname,'rb').read()
    except Exception as ex:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Failed to read file: {ex}\n" if not isinstance(ex, FileNotFoundError) else "Failed to read file: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        return []
    parts=data.split(b'\0' if nul else b'\n')
    return [p.decode(errors='surrogateescape') for p in parts if p]

    value_opts={

        '--collapse':('--collapse','COLLAPSE','str'),

    }
    flags={
        '-p':'full_paths','--full-paths':'full_paths','-L':'deref','--dereference-links':'deref',
        '-x':'limit_filesystem','--limit-filesystem':'limit_filesystem','-s':'apparent','--apparent-size':'apparent',
        '-r':'reverse','--reverse':'reverse','-c':'no_colors','--no-colors':'no_colors','-C':'force_colors','--force-colors':'force_colors',

        '-j':'output_json','--output-json':'output_json'
    }
    i=0; extra_paths=[]
    while i<len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a=='--':
            extra_paths.extend(argv[i+1:]); break
        if a in ('-h','--help'):
            sys.stdout.write(HELP_SHORT if a=='-h' else HELP_LONG); sys.exit(0)
        if a in ('-V','--version'):
            print(VERSION); sys.exit(0)
        if a in flags:
            setattr(opt, flags[a], True); i+=1; continue
        val=None; key=a
        if a.startswith('--') and '=' in a:
            key,val=a.split('=',1)
        if key in value_opts:
            optname, ph, typ=value_opts[key]
            if val is None:
                if i+1>=len(argv):
                    clap_error(f"error: a value is required for '{optname} <{ph}>' but none was supplied")
                val=argv[i+1]; i+=1
            if typ=='int':
                intval=parse_int_value(val,optname,ph)
                if key in ('-d','--depth'): opt.depth=intval
                elif key in ('-n','--number-of-lines'): opt.nlines=intval
                elif key in ('-w','--terminal-width'): opt.width=intval
                # threads ignored
            else:

                elif key in ('-I','--ignore-all-in-file'):
                    try:
                        for line in open(val,encoding='utf-8'):
                            line=line.strip('\n')
                            if line: opt.invert_regex.append(line)
                    except Exception: pass
                elif key in ('-z','--min-size'):
                    opt.min_size=parse_size(val)
                elif key in ('-v','--invert-filter'): opt.invert_regex.append(val)
                elif key in ('-e','--filter'): opt.ignore_regex.append(val)
                elif key in ('-o','--output-format'):
                    if val not in ('si','b','k','m','g','t','kb','mb','gb','tb'):
                        sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '--output-format <FORMAT>'\n  [possible values: si, b, k, m, g, t, kb, mb, gb, tb]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")

                elif key in ('-M','--mtime'): opt.time_filter=('m',val)
                elif key in ('-A','--atime'): opt.time_filter=('a',val)
                elif key in ('-y','--ctime'): opt.time_filter=('c',val)
                elif key in ('--files0-from',): extra_paths.extend(read_paths_from_file(val, True))
                elif key in ('--files-from',): extra_paths.extend(read_paths_from_file(val, False))
                elif key=='--collapse': opt.collapse.append(val)

        extra_paths.append(a); i+=1
    opt.paths=extra_paths or ['.']
    if opt.screen_reader: opt.no_bars=True
    return opt


def should_ignore_path(path, name, opt:Options, is_root=False):
    if is_root: return False
    if opt.ignore_hidden and name.startswith('.'):
        return True
    for pat in opt.ignore_dirs:
        if name==pat or path==pat or os.path.abspath(path)==os.path.abspath(pat): return True
    return False


def time_match(ts, spec):
    m=re.match(r'^([+-]?)(\d+)$', spec or '')
    if not m: return True
    sign,n=m.group(1),int(m.group(2))
    days=int((time.time()-ts)//86400)
    if sign=='+': return days>n
    if sign=='-': return days<n
    return days==n


def filter_file_path(path,opt):
    if opt.ignore_regex:
        ok=False
        for r in opt.ignore_regex:
            try:
                if re.search(r,path): ok=True; break
            except re.error: pass
        if not ok: return False
    for r in opt.invert_regex:
        try:
            if re.search(r,path): return False
        except re.error: pass
    return True


def node_base_size(st,opt,is_regular):
    if opt.filecount:
        return 1 if is_regular else 0
    if opt.filetime:
        if opt.filetime=='a': return int(st.st_atime)
        if opt.filetime=='c': return int(st.st_ctime)
        return int(st.st_mtime)
    if opt.apparent:
        return int(st.st_size)
    return int(getattr(st,'st_blocks',0))*512


def scan(path,opt:Options,is_root=True, root_dev=None, parent=None):
    try:
        st=os.stat(path) if opt.deref else os.lstat(path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None, f"No such file or directory: {path}\n"
    except PermissionError:
        return None, f"Did not have permissions for: {path}\n"
    except Exception as ex:
        return None, f"{ex}: {path}\n"
    name=os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep)) or path
    mode=st.st_mode
    islink=os.path.islink(path)
    isdir=stat.S_ISDIR(mode)
    isreg=stat.S_ISREG(mode)
    if islink and opt.deref:
        islink=False
        isdir=os.path.isdir(path)
        isreg=os.path.isfile(path) and not isdir
    node=Node(path=path,name=name,is_dir=isdir,is_file=isreg,is_symlink=islink,parent=parent)
    if root_dev is None: root_dev=st.st_dev
    if opt.time_filter and isreg:
        kind,spec=opt.time_filter
        ts=st.st_mtime if kind=='m' else (st.st_atime if kind=='a' else st.st_ctime)
        if not time_match(ts,spec):
            return None, None
    include_self=filter_file_path(path,opt) if isreg else True
    base=node_base_size(st,opt,isreg) if include_self else 0
    node.raw_size=base
    if isdir and not (islink and not opt.deref):
        try:
            entries=list(os.scandir(path))
        except PermissionError:
            node.size=base
            return node, (f"Did not have permissions for: {path}\n" if opt.print_errors else None)
        except Exception as ex:
            node.size=base
            return node, (f"{ex}: {path}\n" if opt.print_errors else None)
        total=base if not opt.filetime else base
        child_errors=[]
        for ent in entries:
            cp=ent.path
            cname=ent.name
            if should_ignore_path(cp,cname,opt): continue
            if opt.limit_filesystem:
                try:
                    cst=os.stat(cp) if opt.deref else os.lstat(cp)
                    if cst.st_dev != root_dev: continue
                except Exception: pass
            child,err=scan(cp,opt,False,root_dev,node)
            if err: child_errors.append(err)
            if child is not None:
                node.children.append(child)
                if opt.filetime:
                    total=max(total, child.size)
                else:
                    total += child.size
        node.size=total
        node.sort_children()
        node.error=''.join(child_errors) if child_errors else None
        return node, node.error
    else:
        node.size=base
        return (node if include_self or not isreg else None), None


def fmt_size(n,opt):
    if opt.filecount:
        return str(int(n))
    if opt.filetime:
        try: return time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', time.localtime(n))
        except Exception: return '1970-01-01T00:00:00'
    fmt=opt.outfmt
    if fmt=='auto':
        base=1024; units=['B','K','M','G','T']
        v=float(n); idx=0
        while idx<len(units)-1 and v>=base:
            v/=base; idx+=1
        if idx==0: return f"{int(n)}B"
        if v<10: return f"{v:.1f}{units[idx]}"
        return f"{int(v)}{units[idx]}"
    if fmt=='si':
        base=1000; units=['B','K','M','G','T']
        v=float(n); idx=0
        while idx<len(units)-1 and v>=base:
            v/=base; idx+=1
        if idx==0: return f"{int(n)}B"
        if v<10: return f"{v:.1f}{units[idx]}"
        return f"{int(v)}{units[idx]}"
    mults={'b':(1,'B'),'k':(1024,'K'),'m':(1024**2,'M'),'g':(1024**3,'G'),'t':(1024**4,'T'),
           'kb':(1000,'K'),'mb':(1000**2,'M'),'gb':(1000**3,'G'),'tb':(1000**4,'T')}
    div,suf=mults.get(fmt,(1,'B'))
    return f"{int(n//div)}{suf}"

    if node.name in ('(total)','(no extension)') or node.name.startswith('.') and opt.file_types:
        return node.name

def clone_shallow(n):
    return Node(path=n.path,name=n.name,size=n.size,raw_size=n.raw_size,is_dir=n.is_dir,is_file=n.is_file,is_symlink=n.is_symlink,children=[],parent=n.parent)


def filter_display_tree(root,opt, depth=0):
    # returns a copied/pruned tree for rendering; sizes are original aggregate sizes
    n=clone_shallow(root)
    collapsed=any(root.name==c or root.path==c for c in opt.collapse)
    if opt.depth is not None and depth>=opt.depth:
        return n
    if collapsed:
        return n
    for ch in root.children:
        child=filter_display_tree(ch,opt,depth+1)
        show=True
        if opt.only_file:
            show=(not ch.children)  # files, symlinks, and empty directories
        elif opt.only_dir:
            show=(ch.is_dir or ch.is_symlink or ch.children)
        if opt.min_size is not None and ch.size < opt.min_size:
            show=False
        if show:
            n.children.append(child)
        elif child.children and not opt.only_file:
            # keep matching descendants for regex/time/min filters if useful
            n.children.extend(child.children)
    n.sort_children()
    return n


def flatten_nodes(root, reverse=False, include_root=True):
    res=[]
    def post(n, depth, ancestors, sibling_index, sibling_count):
        for i,ch in enumerate(sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name))):
            post(ch,depth+1,ancestors+[(sibling_index,sibling_count)],i,len(n.children))
        if include_root or depth>0:
            res.append((n,depth,ancestors,sibling_index,sibling_count))
    def pre(n, depth, ancestors, sibling_index, sibling_count):
        if include_root or depth>0:
            res.append((n,depth,ancestors,sibling_index,sibling_count))
        children=sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)
        for i,ch in enumerate(children):
            pre(ch,depth+1,ancestors+[(sibling_index,sibling_count)],i,len(children))
    if reverse: pre(root,0,[],0,1)
    else: post(root,0,[],0,1)
    return res


def count_nodes_excluding_root(n):
    return sum(1+count_nodes_excluding_root(c) for c in n.children)


def prune_by_n(root,opt):
    if opt.nlines is None: return root
    if count_nodes_excluding_root(root) <= opt.nlines: return root
    # select n largest descendants; include ancestors needed to reach them
    allnodes=[]
    def walk(n):
        for c in n.children:
            allnodes.append(c); walk(c)
    walk(root)
    selected=set(id(x) for x in sorted(allnodes,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)[:max(0,opt.nlines)])
    def copy_keep(n, isroot=False):
        cn=clone_shallow(n)
        for c in n.children:
            cc=copy_keep(c)
            if cc is not None:
                cn.children.append(cc)
        keep=isroot or id(n) in selected or cn.children
        cn.sort_children()
        return cn if keep else None
    return copy_keep(root, True)


def make_filetype_tree(root,opt):
    groups: Dict[str,int]={}
    def walk(n):
        if n.children:
            # account for directory/symlink/extensionless self contribution approximately
            extra=max(0,n.raw_size)
            if extra: groups['(no extension)']=groups.get('(no extension)',0)+extra
            for c in n.children: walk(c)
        else:
            base=os.path.basename(n.path)
            ext=os.path.splitext(base)[1]
            key=ext if ext else '(no extension)'
            groups[key]=groups.get(key,0)+n.size
    walk(root)
    total=Node(path='(total)', name='(total)', size=root.size, is_dir=True)
    for k,v in groups.items():
        total.children.append(Node(path=k,name=k,size=v))
    total.sort_children()
    return total


def connector_normal(n, depth, ancestors, idx, cnt, has_children, is_root):
    if is_root:
        return '┌─┴' if has_children else '┌──'
    pref=''
    for aidx,acnt in ancestors[1:]:  # skip synthetic root ancestor context
        pref += ('│ ' if aidx>0 else '  ')
    if has_children:
        conn='┌─┴' if idx==0 else '├─┴'
    else:
        conn='┌──' if idx==0 else '├──'
    return pref+conn


def connector_reverse(n, depth, ancestors, idx, cnt, has_children, is_root):
    if is_root:
        return '└─┬' if has_children else '└──'
    pref=''
    for aidx,acnt in ancestors[1:]:
        pref += ('│ ' if aidx < acnt-1 else '  ')
    last=(idx==cnt-1)
    if has_children:
        conn='└─┬' if last else '├─┬'
    else:
        conn='└──' if last else '├──'
    return pref+conn


def adjust_for_skip(entries):
    # If root is omitted, reduce displayed depth/ancestor context by one level.
    out=[]
    for n,d,anc,idx,cnt in entries:
        out.append((n,max(0,d-1),anc[1:] if anc else [],idx,cnt))
    return out


def render_lines(root,opt):
    include_root=not opt.skip_total
    entries=flatten_nodes(root,opt.reverse,include_root=True)
    if not include_root:
        entries=[e for e in entries if e[1]>0]
        entries=adjust_for_skip(entries)
    # no displayed root for single file and skip-total -> no lines
    if not entries: return []
    size_strs={id(n):fmt_size(n.size,opt) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries}
    sw=max(len(s) for s in size_strs.values())
    plain=[]
    for n,depth,anc,idx,cnt in entries:
        isroot=(depth==0 and include_root)
        has=bool(n.children)
        conn=connector_reverse(n,depth,anc,idx,cnt,has,isroot) if opt.reverse else connector_normal(n,depth,anc,idx,cnt,has,isroot)
        gap=' '
        if include_root and not isroot: gap='   '
        # filetime output in the original has no space after connector
        sep='' if opt.filetime else ' '
        left=f"{size_strs[id(n)]:>{sw}}{gap}{conn}{sep}{display_name(n,opt)}"
        plain.append((left,n,depth,anc))
    if opt.no_bars or opt.screen_reader:
        if opt.screen_reader:
            return render_screen_reader(entries,opt,size_strs)
        return [x[0] for x in plain]
    maxleft=max(len(x[0]) for x in plain)
    width=max(20,opt.width)
    content_width=max(1, width - maxleft - 7)  # bar border + percent field
    total=max(root.size,1)
    # top-level ancestor sizes for shaded branch bars
    def top_ancestor_size(n,anc):
        cur=n
        while cur.parent is not None and cur.parent.parent is not None:
            cur=cur.parent
        return cur.size if cur is not None else n.size
    lines=[]
    for left,n,depth,anc in plain:
        pct=0 if total==0 else int(round(n.size*100/total))
        if opt.filetime: pct=100 if n.size else 0
        full=max(1, int(round((n.size/total)*content_width))) if n.size>0 or total==0 else 1
        full=min(content_width,full)
        shade=0
        if depth>1 and not opt.filetime:
            top=top_ancestor_size(n,anc)
            topfull=max(1,int(round((top/total)*content_width))) if top>0 else 1
            shade=max(0,min(content_width-full, topfull-full))
        if opt.bars_right:
            bar=' '*(content_width-full-shade)+'░'*shade+'█'*full
        else:
            bar='█'*full+'░'*shade+' '*(content_width-full-shade)
        line=left + ' '*(maxleft-len(left)) + '│' + bar + '│' + f"{pct:>4}%"
        if len(line)<width: line += ' '*(width-len(line))
        elif len(line)>width: line=line[:width]
        lines.append(line)
    return lines


def render_screen_reader(entries,opt,size_strs):
    names=[display_name(n,opt) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries]
    maxn=max((len(x) for x in names), default=0)
    maxs=max((len(size_strs[id(n)]) for n,_,_,_,_ in entries), default=0)
    total=max(entries[-1][0].size if not opt.reverse else entries[0][0].size, 1)
    out=[]
    for (n,depth,anc,idx,cnt),name in zip(entries,names):
        pct=0 if total==0 else int(round(n.size*100/total))
        if opt.filetime: pct=100 if n.size else 0
        out.append(f"{name:<{maxn}} {depth} {size_strs[id(n)]:>{maxs}} {pct:>3}%")
    return out


def to_json_obj(n,opt):
    return {"size":fmt_size(n.size,opt),"name":display_name(n,opt),"children":[to_json_obj(c,opt) for c in sorted(n.children,key=lambda c:(c.size,c.name), reverse=True)]}


def maybe_progress(opt):
    if opt.no_progress: return
    # The original emits a short carriage-return spinner on stderr even when captured.
    sys.stderr.write("\r \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... -\r                            \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... \\\r                            \rIndexing:  0 files, 0B ... |\r                            \r")


def main(argv):
    opt=parse_args(argv)
    roots=[]; errors=[]
    for p in opt.paths:
        n,err=scan(p,opt,True)
        if err: errors.append(err)
        if n is not None: roots.append(n)
    if not roots:
        for e in errors: sys.stderr.write(e)
        return 1
    if len(roots)==1:
        root=roots[0]
    else:
        root=Node(path='(total)',name='(total)',is_dir=True,size=sum(r.size for r in roots),children=roots)
        for r in roots: r.parent=root
        root.sort_children()
    if opt.file_types:
        root=make_filetype_tree(root,opt)
    else:
        root=filter_display_tree(root,opt,0)
        root=prune_by_n(root,opt)
    if opt.output_json:
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(to_json_obj(root,opt), separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    else:
        for line in render_lines(root,opt):
            sys.stdout.write(line+'\n')
    for e in errors:
        if e: sys.stderr.write(e)
    maybe_progress(opt)
    return 0

if __name__=='__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
